## Download

Download `lsk.exe` below and put it in a folder of its own: it runs on
Windows, with nothing to install. The
[README](https://github.com/Local-Stream-Kit/Local-Stream-Kit#readme) has
the first start and setting up OBS. An app that's already set up finds
this version itself: Status says it's out, and **Download** puts it in
place.

It isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may warn you the first time:

- The browser may say `lsk.exe` isn't commonly downloaded: choose
  **Keep**.
- Windows may say it protected your PC: choose **More info**, then
  **Run anyway**.

`latest.json` and `latest.json.sig` are for the app's update check.
